- **Post-1945 reality**: 
  - West Germany (FRG) focused on "Wirtschaftswunder" (economic miracle) and EU/NATO integration. Reunified Germany (1990–) became a "Zivilmacht" (civilian power)—leading via trade, diplomacy, not force.

- **Recent shifts**: Ukraine invasion (2022) prompted "Zeitenwende" (turning point)—€100B defense fund, Taurus missile debates. Far-right AfD pushes "Dexit" (EU exit) for sovereignty, fueling nationalist rhetoric.
